title: fix(getRefinements): provide attributeName for query
body:
**Summary**

* added attributeName to fix issue https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/3205 and related
* added tests
* added example showcasing onlyListedAttributes on current-refined-values (maybe unnecessary)
